summary: Expose declared seat and mission resources as read-only references

replay.detail: Existing declared-resource edges are folded into an indexed projection in bounded resumable batches after durable store open. Reference reads fall back to declarations until folding completes; API availability does not wait for the full fold.

schema.detail: Adds the declared_resource_edges projection table, target index, declaration-maintenance triggers and resumable backfill metadata without changing the numeric database schema version.

rules.detail: Changes the shared-projection layout identity to declared-resource-edges.v4 and includes declared resource edges in projection digests. Numeric checkpoint rules are unchanged. Mixed-build checkpoint behavior has not been verified; upgrade members together.

compatibility.detail: Adds optional read-only resources to seat and mission client models, GET /v1/resource-references/{subject}, and st subject show --references. Older daemons may omit resources. Cross-version client and daemon pairs have not been exercised.

downtime.detail: Durable projection backfill runs after open in bounded batches with declaration-backed reads during recovery. Restart-to-API and restart-to-health durations have not been measured for existing installations.

manual.detail: No manual declaration migration is required; authored resource names and reasons are preserved and shared URI targets remain reference-only rather than owned seats.

recovery.detail: Backfill resumes from stored progress after interruption. Binary swap-back across the new projection layout and schema objects has not been verified; prefer rolling forward and retain a pre-upgrade backup.
